articles.title: Why Small Talk Is a Big Deal
articles.summary: In an increasingly transactional and screen-mediated world, small talk might matter more than we think, writes Meehika Barua.

articles.title: The Broken Promise of a Home in Spain
articles.summary: The division in Spanish society today runs between those who can still envision a future and those who cannot. Housing is where this line is drawn most sharply.

articles.title: These 2026 Election-Winners Made History in Their States
articles.summary: A number of states elected barrier-breakers—from their first transgender state lawmakers to multiple states’ first Latino or first Black governors.

articles.title: Republicans Went All In on Redistricting Ahead of the Midterms. Why Did It Fail?
articles.summary: Democrats pulled out wins in a number of districts that were reshaped in the effort to bolster Republican candidates, helping to fuel the biggest blue wave in 50 years.

articles.title: No One Should Be Shamed for Using a Mobility Aid
articles.summary: People with disabilities deserve the basic dignity of using the tools that support our bodies without fear of being judged or harassed, writes Nicole Clark.
